security_audit.summary: All 267 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, inline code markers, sample identifiers, and high-entropy Chinese documentation. However, semantic review found unattended global installation, silent agent metadata exposure, and optional log upload risks. Publication should wait until these behaviors require informed user confirmation and safer data handling.

remediation.issue: The skill installs a globally scoped package from the mutable latest tag without confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval, pin a reviewed package version, and display the exact install command before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill exposes agent and model names to the tmeet process without user notice.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the metadata purpose, request consent, and allow login without these values unless they are operationally required.

remediation.issue: The log upload path can send local diagnostic data without mandatory review controls.
remediation.suggestion: Require separate confirmation, show destination and archive contents, redact sensitive values, and default to local export only.

用于控制输出 JSON 的排版形态,**不改变字段内容**。输出结构统一为 `{trace_id, message, data}`。
| `json`(默认) | 单行紧凑 JSON,体积小、便于管道传递 | 模型解析、脚本处理、`jq` 过滤 |
| `json-pretty` | 多行缩进 JSON,可读性强 | 需要将原始结果直接呈现给用户阅读时 |
> - 模型在解析工具输出时**优先使用默认 `json`**,无需显式传入 `--format`;
> - 仅当用户明确要求"以美化/格式化 JSON 展示"或需要把原始 JSON 完整呈现给用户时,才追加 `--format json-pretty`;
> - 即便使用 `json-pretty`,响应处理规则仍然适用——**只展示关键信息,不得擅自聚合或排序**。
布尔开关(默认 `false`),用于**裁剪响应体 `data` 中的字段**,只保留该命令业务上必要的少量字段,从而显著降低输出 token 量。
- 启用后,中间件会根据当前命令的 API 注解从远端拉取"精简字段列表"(compact fields),并对响应 `data` 按该列表进行字段保留;`trace_id`、`message` 等顶
- 若当前命令未声明 API 注解、或远端拉取失败,中间件会**透明放行**,不会阻塞主流程,此时输出等同于未开启 `--compact` 的结果。
- 与 `--format` 相互独立:`--format` 决定 JSON 排版,`--compact` 决定返回字段的数量,两者可同时使用。
> - **查询类命令优先启用**:模型在调用查询/读取类命令时,**默认追加 `--compact`** 以降低上下文占用;
> - **何时不使用**:当用户明确要求"完整结果"、"原始字段"或需要某个非必要字段时,**不要**使用 `--compact`。

content.user_title: Manage Tencent Meetings from the Command Line
content.value_statement: Managing Tencent Meeting from an AI assistant requires many commands, identifiers, permissions, and confirmation steps. This skill routes requests through tmeet with documented privacy and safety checks.
actual_capabilities: Authenticate with Tencent Meeting through OAuth and report login status.
Create, update, cancel, search, and list meetings with time and pagination controls.
Add, remove, replace, and review meeting invitees after required confirmations.
Find recordings, playback addresses, smart minutes, transcripts, and permission status.
Retrieve participant, waiting room, export, and asynchronous report results.
Call or remove participants and manage waiting room movement with identity checks.
limitations: The tmeet CLI, npm, network access, and a Tencent Meeting account are required.
Most commands require OAuth login and permissions granted by Tencent Meeting.
Directory searches are limited to meeting invitations and call workflows.
Meeting mutations, participant control, permission requests, and feedback require user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Schedule Team Meetings
use_cases.description: Create or update meetings, resolve invitees, and confirm notifications before changes.

use_cases.title: Review Recordings and Transcripts
use_cases.description: Locate permitted recordings, retrieve minutes, and search transcript passages for follow-up work.

use_cases.title: Manage Live Meeting Access
use_cases.description: Review participants, call invitees, remove attendees, and manage waiting room movement safely.

prompt_templates.title: Check Login
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Tencent Meeting login status and explain any required next step.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Tencent Meeting titled [topic] from [start time with zone] to [end time with zone].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Invitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [person] and prepare an invitation to meeting [meeting code]. Ask me to confirm before changing invitees.

prompt_templates.title: Research Recorded Discussion
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recordings for [date range], search transcripts for [keyword], and summarize matching passages. Respect permissions and pagination limits.

output_examples.input: Check whether I am signed in.
output_examples.output: You are signed in. The access credential is valid, and its secret value was not displayed.

output_examples.input: Invite Chen Wei to the weekly planning meeting.
output_examples.output: Prepared invitation for Chen Wei to Weekly Planning, meeting number 482 731 905. Confirm before I send the invitation.

output_examples.input: Find recordings from last week that mention launch readiness.
output_examples.output: Found two permitted recordings with matching transcript passages. One additional recording requires access approval before review.

best_practices: Provide complete times with time zones and clarify ambiguous meeting identifiers.
Review every destructive or notification-producing action before confirming execution.
Use compact results first, then request more pages only when needed.
anti_patterns: Do not use the directory as a general employee information lookup service.
Do not expose access tokens, refresh tokens, internal meeting identifiers, or unnecessary personal data.
Do not select among duplicate people or perform sensitive changes without explicit confirmation.

faq.question: What must be installed?
faq.answer: The tmeet CLI and npm must be available. Network access is required for installation and Tencent Meeting operations.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: The CLI starts an OAuth flow and stores credentials locally. Most operations require a valid login.

faq.question: Can it search the company directory?
faq.answer: Yes, but only to resolve people for meeting invitations or calls. General employee lookup is prohibited.

faq.question: Can it read every recording?
faq.answer: No. Recording access depends on Tencent Meeting permissions, ownership, passwords, and approval status.

faq.question: Which actions require confirmation?
faq.answer: Meeting changes, invitee changes, participant controls, logout, recording permission requests, and feedback submission require confirmation.

faq.question: Does it upload diagnostic data?
faq.answer: It supports optional log upload and feedback submission. Review and approve any data before it leaves the device.
